name: Conceptual Physics Practice Sets Course Profile
role: Instantiate finalized Bank-v2 Practice family seeds into deterministic classroom Practice artifacts; reproduce CYU exact-content; preserve the established Practice HTML/CSS shell.

bank_v2.selection_rule: Hard I-can/evidence/representation constraints first, then deterministic tie-break; rotate omissions when constraints allow.
bank_v2.variant_rule: Instantiate only validated controlled variants from canonical_seed + transformation contract; preserve locked learning/evidence/structure/difficulty fields.

response_mode: Practice/CYU follow the instantiated/canonical item response mode; Blooket is selected response. Required representations must remain executable.
representation_rule: Preserve the finalized family/CYU representation contract. Reference canonical course assets in place, preserve semantic tables/inline SVG, copy Bank-local figure bytes only when the route requires a local artifact copy, and never invoke the graph tool downstream.
package: section folders directly at ZIP root for extraction into practice_sets/, plus _practice_provenance/unitN/

artifact_self_containment.rule: Finished Practice must be repairable without the Bank Map.
artifact_self_containment.answer_visibility: answers/solutions live in artifact-local handoff, never visibly in student Practice HTML

resolution_order: copy dedicated finalized-Bank export when present
otherwise derive downstream under this explicit Physics authorization
game_exports.source_scope: nonsecure same-section canonical Practice family content only; never Exit or Summative
